Meta.title: Aplica
Meta.description: Paste a job posting, get a resume and cover letter in your real voice.

Home.title: Aplica
Home.tagline: Paste a job posting, get a resume and cover letter in your real voice, that does not sound like AI.
Home.status: The shell is running. Fonts, translations and motion are wired. The design system comes next.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Pick up where you left off.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.lead: An email and a password. Your CV and your model key come after.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: If that address needs a link, it’s on its way. Open it in this browser and you’ll land back here signed in.
checkEmail.hint: Nothing yet? Give it a minute, then look in spam.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lead: Type your email and we’ll send you a link to set a new one.

newPassword.title: Set a new password
newPassword.lead: This replaces the old one everywhere.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don’t match an account.
errors.emailTaken: That address already has an account. Sign in instead.
errors.rateLimited: That was a lot of tries. Wait a minute and go again.
errors.link: That link didn’t work. It may have expired, so ask for a new one.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.

Account.title: Your account
Account.lead: Where your key lives, what language you get, and how to leave.

key.title: Your model key
key.body: Aplica runs on your own provider key, so you pay the model directly and we never mark it up. It is encrypted before it reaches the database, and it is never shown again after you save it.
key.label: API key
key.hint: We check it works before we store it.
key.replace: Pasting a new one replaces it.
key.none: No key yet. Paste one and you can generate an application.

errors.rejected: That key didn’t work. Check you copied all of it, and that it belongs to {provider}.
errors.unreachable: We couldn’t reach {provider} to check the key. Try again in a minute.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Your key was not saved.

language.title: Language
language.body: This changes the app. It does not change the language your applications are written in.

danger.title: Delete your account
danger.body: This removes your profile, your parsed CV, the file you uploaded, every application you generated, and your encrypted key. It cannot be undone.
danger.confirmHint: This is the last step. There is no undo after it.
danger.mismatch: That does not match your email address.
danger.failed: Something went wrong, so your account is still here. Try again.

errors.unauthorized: Your session ran out. Sign in and try again.
errors.bad_request: Something in that request was off. Try again.
errors.key_missing: You need a model key before you can generate. Add one in your account.
errors.name_missing: We need your name before we write anything, because it goes on the documents. Add it in your account.
errors.profile_missing: Upload your CV first. Everything is drawn from it.
errors.profile_unreadable: Your stored profile no longer matches what we expect. Upload your CV again.
errors.rate_limited: That is {limit} applications today, which is the daily limit. It resets at midnight UTC.
errors.provider_rejected_key: Your provider turned the key down. Check it is still valid in your account.
errors.provider_rate_limited: Your provider is rate limiting you. Wait a minute and go again.
errors.provider_refused: Your provider refused the request. Try again.
errors.provider_unavailable: Your provider is having trouble. Nothing is wrong with your key. Try again shortly.
errors.provider_timeout: That took too long and stopped. Try again.
errors.generation_invalid: The model returned something we could not use. Try again.
errors.application_not_found: We could not find that application.
errors.application_unreadable: That application was saved before we could re-create its files. Generate it again.
errors.render_failed: We wrote the application but could not turn it into files. Try the download again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.

Styleguide.title: The design system
Styleguide.intro: Every value this product is allowed to use, shown doing its real job on the real paper. If a screen needs something that is not here, the system is wrong, not the screen.

color.green-soft: Text at 20px and up, icons, graphics
color.human: The motif and the result reveal, nothing else

pairs.body: Body text sits here, at full ink.
pairs.secondary: Secondary text carries the quieter half of a screen.
pairs.greenSoft: Green at twenty pixels and up
pairs.note: Judged on the surface it actually lands on, never on white.

type.sample: Paste the posting, keep your voice

motion.easing: One easing family: a soft spring with high damping. Nothing bounces, nothing spins, nothing scales up from zero. Reduced motion swaps all of it for instant states.

button.note: One green action per screen. Everything else is an outline or plain text.

field.keyHint: Stored encrypted. You can delete it any time.
field.postingPlaceholder: Paste the posting here. The whole thing is fine.
field.postingError: Paste a few more lines so there is something to work from.

card.title: Senior product designer
card.body: Tailored two days ago. The resume kept every line from your profile and dropped nothing.
card.emptyBody: Paste your first posting and it will show up here.
